department: Department of Atmospheric and Oceanic Sciences

deadline.value: Applications are due December 1 for fall admission (year inferred for Fall 2027).

gre_general.value: GRE scores are neither required nor considered.
gre_general.quote: We do not require and will not consider General Record Examination (GRE) scores.

supervisor.value: Admission is by committee, but applicants are encouraged to contact faculty about openings.
supervisor.quote: Our department's admissions decisions are made by a committee - not by a single faculty member or research advisor. | Prospective students are also encouraged to reach out to individual faculty members directly

funding.value: Almost all admitted doctoral students are offered TA or RA support with tuition remission and a stipend.
funding.quote: Almost all admitted doctoral students are offered financial support from the department

entry_route.value: A baccalaureate degree or equivalent is required; ATOC admits primarily PhD students.
entry_route.quote: Hold a baccalaureate degree from a college or university of recognized standing, or have done work equivalent to that required for such a degree.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

notes: English minimums follow the university default.
